Header.classes: sticky top-0 z-50 w-full backdrop-blur-xl bg-bolt-elements-bg-depth-1/80 border-b border-bolt-elements-borderColor h-[var(--header-height)]

Sidebar.classes: flex flex-col h-full border-r border-bolt-elements-borderColor bg-bolt-elements-bg-depth-2/50 backdrop-blur-xl

Chat.message_user: bg-bolt-elements-bg-depth-3/50 backdrop-blur-sm border border-white/5 rounded-2xl px-6 py-4

Button.primary: rounded-lg px-4 py-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-violet-600 text-white hover:opacity-90 transition-all shadow-lg shadow-blue-500/20 font-medium
Button.secondary: rounded-lg px-4 py-2 bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-bolt-elements-textPrimary border border-white/10 transition-colors
Button.ghost: rounded-lg px-4 py-2 hover:bg-white/5 text-bolt-elements-textSecondary hover:text-bolt-elements-textPrimary transition-colors

step_1_uno_config.action: Update BASE_COLORS with the new Zinc (Gray) and Blue/Violet (Accent) palettes. Add glassmorphism shortcuts.
step_1_uno_config.code_snippet_hint: Replace BASE_COLORS with the new palette defined in colors.palette. Add shortcuts: 'glass': 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10'.

step_2_css_variables.action: Update :root[data-theme='dark'] variables to match the new 'tokens'.

step_3_global_styles.action: Ensure the scrollbar matches the dark theme (thin, zinc-800 thumb).

step_4_components.action: Refactor Header, Chat, and Sidebar components to use the new 'glass' and 'depth' classes.

do: Use 'Zinc' (Gray) scale for neutrals to achieve that premium 'Bolt/Vercel' look.
Use subtle borders (opacity 5-10%) instead of heavy shadows for separation.
Use backdrop-blur for overlays and sticky headers.
Ensure text contrast meets WCAG AA (Text Secondary should be Zinc-400, not darker).
Add micro-interactions (scale-95 on click, fade-in on load).
dont: DO NOT use pure black (#000000) for backgrounds. Use #09090b.
DO NOT use gradients for text unless it's a very large heading.
DO NOT make the UI too dense; give padding to the chat bubbles.
